title: A Knight Needs a Sidekick
summary: A new name, a questionable helmet, and a man determined to become a hero. What does a good sidekick owe him?
questions: Which details come from Cervantes, and which belong to the game?
What can a name promise—and what can it actually change?

title: The Castle That Served Supper
summary: An ordinary inn becomes a castle in Quixote’s imagination. Playing along is easy—until someone gets hurt.
questions: Why do different people go along with Quixote?
When does a joke become someone else’s problem?
How does the ordinary setting undercut the heroic language?

title: The Promise Left Behind
summary: A rescue, a promise, and the people left behind. Follow the distance between believing you helped and actually helping.
questions: What does the reader know that Quixote does not?
Why does a promise fail to protect Andrés?
How does Pedro’s practical help compare with Quixote’s heroism?

title: The Door That Disappeared
summary: The library goes on trial, a doorway vanishes, and Sancho follows a promise. Can you remove a story by hiding its books?
questions: Do the priest and barber judge every book by the same rule?
How does Quixote explain evidence that should challenge his beliefs?
What does Sancho hope to gain, and how does it differ from Quixote’s hope?

title: The Windmills
summary: The next adventure is on the horizon. This space is reserved for the windmills finale.
